_readme: Tickers here get an automatic price/insider-transaction/news/analyst-rating refresh every Radar scan (~every 2h), grouped by theme for the Capital Rotation view. This exists because the scan job runs in GitHub Actions, which has no access to your local/deployed Watchlist database (gitignored, never committed) -- see README 'Radar' section. US-listed tickers only for now. Edit the theme lists yourself whenever you want a ticker added, removed, or reclassified, then commit and push. 'Other' holds tickers that don't fit the six named themes (SMCI/NBIS/IREN/CLS/BE are AI data-center infrastructure, PLTR is AI software, ABCL is biotech) -- not dropped, just not force-fit into a theme they don't belong to. 'Humanoid Robotics' has no constituents yet -- none of the originally-given 31 tickers are humanoid-robotics companies; Radar's existing Humanoids niche still covers that theme via news findings, just not via ticker snapshots.
